description: NaCaFeAl(SiO₃)₄ is Esseneite-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.92 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.88 Å. There are two inequivalent Ca sites. In the first Ca site, Ca is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.82 Å. In the second Ca site, Ca is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.75 Å. There are two inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one FeO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one AlO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 2.08-2.20 Å. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent FeO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 2.10-2.14 Å. There are two inequivalent Al sites. In the first Al site, Al is bonded to six O atoms to form AlO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one FeO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one AlO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Al-O bond distances ranging from 1.92-2.07 Å. In the second Al site, Al is bonded to six O atoms to form AlO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent AlO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Al-O bond distances ranging from 1.88-2.13 Å. There are six inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three AlO₆ octahedra and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 30-59°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.68 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one FeO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent AlO₆ octahedra, and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 32-65°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.68 Å. In the third Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three AlO₆ octahedra and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 31-59°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.67 Å. In the fourth Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three FeO₆ octahedra and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 39-60°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.59-1.70 Å. In the fifth Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one AlO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent FeO₆ octahedra, and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 36-65°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.59-1.70 Å.
